OBSERVED.definition: Factual properties of the production routing and runtime execution as recorded in the tamper-evident journal.

COUNTERFACTUAL.definition: The shadow recommendation that was explicitly NOT executed during production runtime.

DERIVED.definition: Mathematically exact calculations computed from valid journal records, including readiness scores, agreement counts, and divergence rates.

ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL.definition: Hypothetical opportunity classifications indicating conditions under which shadow routing would have diverged.

UNKNOWN.definition: All causal assertions about empirical cost savings, quality differences, or promotion fitness prior to a controlled intervention.

inviolable_principles: READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN does not mean the shadow route is superior.
READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN does not mean promotion is authorized.
Synthetic test fixtures can never be counted as live empirical evidence.
